title: Facebook — recently closed Falcon 900EX EASy
hook: Another one across the finish line.
body:
Another one across the finish line.

We recently closed a 2008 Falcon 900EX EASy — a three-engine, large-cabin Falcon that's still one of the most capable airplanes in its class. Every deal is its own puzzle: the inspection, the logbooks, the negotiation, the timing. Getting one to the closing table cleanly is the whole job, and it's the part we love.

Buying or selling a large-cabin jet this year? Let's talk — quietly, and on your timeline.
cta: Considering a sale? Know your position first — link in bio.
media_notes: Social proof. Discreet — no client named, no reason for the transaction.
